newsitem.title: USA: Tele-Comms to boost rates 7 pct - report.
newsitem.headline: Tele-Comms to boost rates 7 pct - report.

text.p: Tele-Communications Inc will announce today a plan to raise rates more than 7 percent from June, USA Today reported Thursday.
The report said the plan would increase average monthly fees to more than $27 for about 9 million of the company's 14 million customers.
It said TCI President Leo Hindery believed customers would accept the rate hike after reading the company's explanations, to be included in monthly bills.
Shares of Tele-Communications Inc closed Wednesday down 1/8 at 13.
